gloss_en: Problems with IFC files: opening and re-saving an IFC in another format loses the coordinates it carried.
title_original: Problemas con IFC's
question_paraphrase: problemas con los ifc: al abrirlo y guardarlo en otro formato se pierden las coordenadas que traia
phrasing_notes: Spanish forum thread; plural apostrophe 'IFC's' (English-style); short, no version given
answer_summary: Verify coordinates after each conversion; link the IFC rather than re-saving; Navisworks NWD or a new-project link as workarounds.

gloss_en: Generic-model family mapped to IfcBuildingElementProxy disappears from the IFC export; switching the class to IfcStairs fixes it.
title_original: Quesion: IFC mapping, dissappearing objects in export
question_paraphrase: an escalator family (generic model, class IfcBuildingElementProxy) does not show up in the exported IFC
answer_summary: Change the IFC class name in the export mapping table from proxy to a specific class such as IfcStairs.

gloss_en: How to map Revit parameters to IFC; add an IFCExportAs shared parameter so heaters export as IfcSpaceHeater.
title_original: Mapping of Revit Parameters to IFC Parameters for Export
question_paraphrase: wants to control which IFC class and properties each family gets; adds IFCExportAs per family
answer_summary: IFCExportAs/IFCExportType shared parameters take precedence over category mapping; Psets need a user-defined mapping file.

gloss_en: IFCExportAs and IFCExportType set to IfcAudioVisualAppliance are ignored; elements still export as IfcBuildingElementProxy.
title_original: IFC Parameters IFCExportAs and IFCExportType not outputting to IFC file
question_paraphrase: added IFCExportAs/IFCExportType text values to a family but output IFC still shows IfcBuildingElementProxy
phrasing_notes: States exact values typed; mild frustration
answer_summary: Check that the schema supports the class, parameter spelling and binding (type vs instance), and exporter version.

gloss_en: Type parameters are not exported into IFC property sets of instances.
title_original: Issues with exporting type parameters from Revit to IFC
question_paraphrase: type parameters missing in IFC property sets after export
answer_summary: Tick 'Allow use of type properties in instance property sets' in the export setup.

gloss_en: Only type parameters appear in the Pset export; instance parameters are missing.
title_original: IFC export - Pset - only type parameters exporting
question_paraphrase: custom Pset export only brings type parameters
answer_summary: Check the Pset mapping txt and parameter binding.

gloss_en: User-defined properties do not export when a Revit shared-parameter file is used instead of the IFC pset txt format.
title_original: Revit IFC Export user defined properties won't export
question_paraphrase: pointed 'user defined property sets' to the shared parameter file; nothing exported
phrasing_notes: Common confusion between two txt formats
answer_summary: The user-defined Pset file has its own format; a Revit shared parameter file does not work for it.

gloss_en: Revit 2027 new Parameter Mapping UI shows empty lists for some classes and cannot map two parameters to one IFC property.
title_original: Ifc export in 2027 - mapping parameters severely lacking
question_paraphrase: new graphical parameter mapping shows empty lists for IfcBeam, IfcPile; replaces pset.txt
context_given: Export IFC > Modify Setup > Parameter Mapping
answer_summary: Autodesk reply: known issue, fix in an upcoming update, no ETA.

gloss_en: Properties missing on export with a custom property set mapping txt; unit mismatch between Revit and IFC schema.
title_original: Missing properties when exporting IFC from Revit using custom property set mapping TXT file
question_paraphrase: custom mapping txt properties absent in the output
answer_summary: Parameter type/unit in the txt must match the IFC schema type.

gloss_en: Steel connections mapped to IfcBuildingElementProxy do not appear in the IFC export.
title_original: Steel connections - IFC exporter
question_paraphrase: structural connections missing from the IFC
answer_summary: Known limitation of the exporter in that version.

gloss_en: Reply advises that standards discourage IfcBuildingElementProxy since it is a catch-all that comes from generic models.
title_original: PSet parameters
question_paraphrase: discussion on Pset parameters; a reply recommends avoiding proxy
answer_summary: Assign a specific class where one exists.

answer_summary: Solved thread; exporter settings.

gloss_en: dRofus recommends exporting from a 3D view with in-session settings, IFC2x3 Coordination View, rooms as spaces, Revit property sets on.
title_original: Optimal settings for Ifc Export from Revit
question_paraphrase: settings list
answer_summary: Settings list.

gloss_en: Count proxies and group by origin category
prompt: cuantos IfcBuildingElementProxy hay en el ifc y de que categorias de revit vienen?
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by ObjectType/Revit category, suggest mapping fixes.

gloss_en: Check why shared parameters did not reach the IFC
prompt: he exportado a ifc y no me salen los parametros compartidos en los psets, mira a ver cuales faltan en los muros
expected_behavior: List Psets/properties on IfcWall, compare with the expected shared parameters, report missing and probable causes (export Revit property sets, mapping txt).

gloss_en: Check model against Plan BIM style delivery requirements
prompt: tengo que entregar el modelo para una licitacion con Plan BIM, revisa que el IFC tenga todas las plantas, espacios y clasificacion en cada elemento
expected_behavior: Check IfcBuildingStorey, IfcSpace and classification references per element; list gaps; note the exact requirements come from the EIR/pliego.

gloss_en: Reassign generic model elements to proper classes
prompt: los modelos genericos salen como proxy, pasalos a IfcColumn los que tengan 'pilar' en el nombre
expected_behavior: Select proxies whose name contains 'pilar', change class to IfcColumn (or advise setting IFCExportAs in Revit), report counts.

gloss_en: IFC opens far from origin
prompt: abro el ifc en revit y sale lejisimos del origen, no se ve nada. por que?
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcSite placement/map conversion and coordinates, explain large coordinates, suggest a shared coordinates workflow.

gloss_en: List storeys with elevations
prompt: dime las plantas del modelo con su cota y cuantos elementos tiene cada una
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey with Elevation and contained element counts.

gloss_en: Quantities of walls per level for budget
prompt: necesito mediciones de muros por planta en m2 y m3 para el presupuesto
expected_behavior: Read Qto_WallBaseQuantities or compute, group by storey, flag missing quantities.

gloss_en: Best export settings for coordination
prompt: que configuracion uso para exportar ifc desde revit para coordinacion, 2x3 o ifc4?
expected_behavior: Explain Coordination View 2x3 vs IFC4 Reference View, enable property sets, export rooms as spaces.

gloss_en: Compare two IFC versions
prompt: compara el ifc de ayer con el de hoy, que elementos nuevos o borrados hay
expected_behavior: Compare by GlobalId, list added/removed/modified, summarize by class.

gloss_en: Find ducts without system
prompt: hay conductos que no esten en ningun sistema? sacame la lista
expected_behavior: Check IfcDistributionSystem assignments for IfcDuctSegment, list unassigned.

gloss_en: Check COBie readiness
prompt: para la entrega a mantenimiento, comprueba que los equipos tengan marca, modelo y numero de serie
expected_behavior: Check Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation fields on equipment, report missing.

gloss_en: Openings missing in exported IFC
prompt: las ventanas no hacen hueco en el muro en el ifc, que pasa?
expected_behavior: Check IfcOpeningElement/IfcRelVoidsElement presence, find walls with windows lacking voids, explain causes.

gloss_en: Check basic CTE-related data
prompt: revisa si los espacios tienen superficie y uso asignado para el CTE
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with area and usage, flag missing.

gloss_en: Fix material names
prompt: los materiales vienen con nombres raros, listame los distintos y unifica los de hormigon
expected_behavior: List IfcMaterial names, propose normalized names, apply on request.

gloss_en: Python snippet to list properties
prompt: como saco con ifcopenshell todas las propiedades de los muros a un excel?
expected_behavior: Explain ifcopenshell.util.element.get_psets and export with pandas.

gloss_en: Total area per room name
prompt: dame la superficie total por tipo de estancia
expected_behavior: Sum area of IfcSpace grouped by name/LongName.

gloss_en: Check classification coverage
prompt: que porcentaje de elementos tiene clasificacion (uniclass o gtc)?
expected_behavior: Compute share of elements with IfcClassificationReference, list unclassified classes.
